avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

lines.label: Road
lines.text: Cayuse Pass is open for the season. Reports have ended for this season. Traditionally weather and road conditions are reported from November 1 to April 1. Should adverse weather occur that will impact travel, updates will be provided as information is available

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 13 to 23 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Cayuse Pass
evidence.detail: left May 20; earlier seasons: June 8 (2023), June 16 (2024), June 12 (2025)

evidence.name: Morse Lake
evidence.detail: left May 26; earlier seasons: June 13 (2023), June 23 (2024), June 18 (2025)

evidence.name: Bumping Ridge
evidence.detail: left May 6; earlier seasons: May 19 (2023), May 18 (2024), May 22 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

evidence.name: Cayuse Pass
evidence.detail: 29.8 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 62.5 in (2023), 40.1 in (2024), 65.4 in (2025)

evidence.name: Morse Lake
evidence.detail: 33.2 in on April 4; earlier seasons: 57.3 in (2023), 46.7 in (2024), 59.6 in (2025)

evidence.name: Bumping Ridge
evidence.detail: 16.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 23.8 in (2023), 21.8 in (2024), 26.8 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 15 and June 5, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Cayuse Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 20, 585 ft above the pass; points to April 14 to June 5

evidence.name: Morse Lake
evidence.detail: melted out May 26, 725 ft above the pass; points to April 16 to June 9

evidence.name: Bumping Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out May 6, 75 ft below the pass; points to April 15 to May 29
